item.title: 🇷🇺 On November 1, Russia's Federation Council delegation led by its Speaker Valentina Matvienko
item.description: 🇷🇺 🇨🇳 On November 1, Russia's Federation Council delegation led by its Speaker Valentina Matvienko arrived in the People’s Republic of China. On November 2, Valentina Matvienko and Chairman of the Standing Committee of China’s National People’s Congress Zhao Leji held a meeting in Beijing . During their talks at the Great Hall of the People, the two officials noted that regular and productive interparliamentary ties reflect t he high level of Russia-China cooperation . They emphasised that President of Russia Vladimir Putin and President of China Xi Jinping maintain close contact ( 1 , 2 , 3 ). At their meetings in Beijing and Bishkek this year, the Leaders reached important agreements that set the course for cooperation between Russia and China. ✉️
President of Russia Vladimir Putin
sent a message of greetings
to participants and guests of
the Peoples of Russia International Week
(November 2, 2026)
💬
Welcome to
the Peoples of Russia International Week
.
This year’s Forum has brought together representatives of government, business, academia and the expert community to discuss a wide range of issues related to
making state ethnic policy more effective
and
strengthening international humanitarian cooperation.
I would like to emphasise that
we deeply cherish Russia's rich historical, cultural and spiritual heritage
and make it a priority to preserve the languages, distinctive traditions and customs of the peoples living in Russia.
☝️
It is particularly important that
indigenous peoples’ associations and communities, civic organisations and volunteer groups
play an active part in this extensive, constructive work.
I would especially like to highlight
The Soul of Russia
, an undoubtedly multifaceted project. Its widely supported initiatives and educational and outreach programmes
help
develop and promote
renowned traditional arts and crafts, national sports, and new and exciting tourist destinations.
I am confident that your Forum, held during
the Year of Unity of the Peoples of Russia
, will be
a major event
in the public and cultural life of our country and other states,
helping to strengthen international humanitarian dialogue and professional and personal ties.
🤝
I wish you success, fruitful exchanges and all the very best.
VLADIMIR PUTIN

item.title: 🗓 On October 31, the meeting of the #G20 Foreign Ministers under the US chairmanship concluded in Atlanta, Georgia, USA
item.description: 🗓 On October 31, the meeting of the #G20 Foreign Ministers under the US chairmanship concluded in Atlanta, Georgia, USA . item.title: 🎙 Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s statement on the expiry of the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara
item.description: 🎙 Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s statement on the expiry of the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (November 1, 2026) 💬 On October 31, the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara expired . Although consensus on a final settlement of the Western Sahara issue has yet to be reached, the US, seeking to artificially accelerate the settlement process, began insisting on the eve of that date on a drastic reduction in the Mission's powers , including abandoning the organisation of a referendum, even though the directly interested parties, including Morocco and Algeria, agreed on the importance of giving the people of Western Sahara the opportunity to determine their own destiny. ❌ Russia could not support the intention to deprive the people of Western Sahara of their right to vote , but the US opposed extending the previous mandate, thereby bringing the Mission to the brink of liquidation . We regret the removal of the basis for the presence of UN representatives in Western Sahara. Nevertheless, we expect the political settlement process to continue, making it possible to find, among the various options for the territory’s status, the solution best suited to the local population . We remain in close contact with our Algerian, Moroccan and other partners on this issue.

item.title: 🎙 Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s answer to a media question
item.description: 🎙 Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s answer to a media question on the current situation surrounding Iran (November 2, 2026) ❓ Question: Recent media reports suggest that new military action against Iran is being planned. How would you comment on the current situation surrounding Iran? 💬 Maria Zakharova: The situation surrounding Iran, which has been subjected to unprovoked aggression by the US and Israel , remains complex . The conflict is still unresolved and continues to reverberate across the Middle Eas t, intertwining with other crises in the region. Reports that further military action against the Islamic Republic is being planned are a cause for grave concern . The tragic experience of recent months demonstrates that military ventures sowing death and destruction in Iran cannot break the Iranian people’s resolve to defend their country’s sovereignty and independence . 👉 Those threatening new strikes today should reflect on this . We support the mediators’ efforts and are helping to advance the negotiating process. ❗️ We reaffirm our readiness to contribute both to finding mutually acceptable solutions and to their subsequent implementation . Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov discussed these issues with Arab and Iranian representatives during his recent visit to the region . 🎙
Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova’s
answer to a media question
on the current situation surrounding Iran
(November 2, 2026)
❓
Question: Recent media reports suggest that new military action against Iran is being planned. How would you comment on the current situation surrounding Iran?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
The situation surrounding Iran, which has been subjected to
unprovoked aggression by the US and Israel
, remains
complex
.
The conflict is still unresolved and continues to reverberate across the Middle Eas
t, intertwining with other crises in the region.
Reports that further military action against the Islamic Republic is being planned are
a cause for grave concern
.
The tragic experience of recent months demonstrates that military ventures sowing death and destruction in Iran
cannot break the Iranian people’s resolve to defend their country’s sovereignty and independence
.
👉
Those threatening new strikes today
should reflect on this
.
We believe diplomatic efforts to normalise the situation must be stepped up.
We support the mediators’ efforts and are helping to advance the negotiating process.
❗️
We reaffirm our readiness to contribute both to finding mutually acceptable solutions and to their subsequent implementation
. Russia's Foreign Minister
Sergey Lavrov
discussed these issues with Arab and Iranian representatives during
his recent visit to the region
.
We hope that the situation in the Strait of Hormuz will return to normal as soon as possible
, with due regard for the legitimate interests of both the littoral states and countries seeking safe and unimpeded passage through this waterway, which is vital to the global economy. This applies fully to Iran as well, as it faces an unlawful US naval blockade.
We welcome the high-level meeting
held in Tehran on October 26 between Iran and the parties to
the so-called Mecca Pact
. Constructive dialogue between neighbours, the restoration of mutual trust and mutual respect for security interests are
essential
.
☝️
This approach underpins
Russia’s Concept of Collective Security in the Persian Gulf,
which seeks to promote
an indivisible security architecture in this strategically important region
, free from destructive outside interference.
